identity.note: Official and author-endorsed: the zhihuanglab GitHub org (Zhi Huang Group) and HF account are the authors' own, the arXiv abstract links the repo, and the HF card links the paper. Not a duplicate: no VISTA/vistapath name, alias or URL in the baseline. MISMATCH: arXiv 2601.16451 (v1 only, 23 Jan 2026) describes trainable PLIP image + frozen PLIP text encoders at 224x224 input. The checkpoint now on HF and GitHub (identical LFS sha256 d263cf07..., 530,927,319 B, added 2026-08-20) uses a different architecture: a Mask2Former Swin-small trunk initialised from ADE20K, the PLIP text tower only, a frozen SAM-ViT-B prompt encoder, 512 px input and 20 queries. It replaced the Jan 2026 checkpoint (sha256 1ba1a409..., 670,498,094 B) whose code matched the paper (CLIPModel PLIP, 224x224). Commit 21bd0355 calls it the 'new PLIP + Mask2Former + SAM-prompt-encoder architecture'. The current backbones.py docstring calls it a 'Variant of models_v3_debug_segment_debug that fixes the conditioning pooling bug'. No paper version, report or model card describes or evaluates the released checkpoint, so the paper's benchmarks and survival results cannot be attributed to the released weights.

scope.note: Borderline but consistent with precedent. It is a pretrained, promptable, class-aware tissue segmentation model trained across 9 organs and 93 classes, with box-guided human-in-the-loop refinement and downstream TIS survival features. It covers one task family (semantic segmentation), which matches the CellSAM precedent (displayed, spatial). CellSAM's audit note rests on 'paper, Apache inference code, and weights match', and that is exactly what VISTA-PATH currently lacks. Modality spatial is correct for H&E pathology.

artifact.note: Weights exist and are ungated: HF zhihuanglab/VISTA-PATH has pytorch_model.bin (530,927,319 B, sha256 d263cf07...), created 2026-08-20. The same object is the Git LFS pointer in GitHub checkpoints/. Not downloaded. The artifact is real, but it is not the model the paper describes (see identity). The proposal omitted two access routes. (1) An ungated HF dataset zhihuanglab/VISTA-PATH_data, created 2026-08-31: the train split of 9 of the source datasets, 158,834 image-mask pairs, 237.2 GiB, a subset of the training corpus. (2) The TissueLab interactive demo, which needs a TissueLab login. At first run, inference pulls vinid/plip, facebook/mask2former-swin-small-ade-semantic and facebook/sam-vit-base from the Hub. Not checked: whether the Jan 2026 paper-era LFS object is still served (the LFS batch query returned no object list).

terms.note: The Penn Academic Software License is byte-identical (whitespace-normalised) in the GitHub LICENSE and the HF LICENSE (6,049 B). Clause 4: internal research or non-commercial use only; no distribution or transfer without PENN's written permission; no commercial rights. Clause 9: no reverse engineering, and derivatives are owned by PENN. Clause 15: either party may terminate on 30 days' notice. GitHub API spdx is NOASSERTION; HF cardData is license 'other', license_name 'penn-academic-software-license'. noncommercial=true is correct. The proposed status wording is accurate for code and weights but incomplete. The data subset is under license_name 'see-source-datasets' (each source dataset keeps its provider's terms). The runtime dependency vinid/plip has no licence metadata on HF, and PLIP itself is held in the register for unresolved reuse terms. Mask2Former checkpoint licence is 'other'; SAM is apache-2.0. The HF card's own licence summary ('with attribution... requires prior approval') paraphrases; the LICENSE file governs.

urls.note: All three proposed URLs fetched with HTTP 200 and show what their labels claim: arXiv abs (VISTA-PATH paper), GitHub repo (official code, LICENSE, README linking paper/model/data), HF model (weights + card). GitHub blob HTML pages intermittently returned 503 to curl; the same content was read via the authenticated GitHub API (200).

text.note: The description conflates two models: 'conditions Mask2Former-style segmentation' describes the Aug 2026 checkpoint, while '1.6 million image-mask-text triplets spanning 9 organs and 93 tissue classes' is the paper's claim for the PLIP-image-encoder model. The paper never mentions Mask2Former. Lab attribution (Zhi Huang lab, Penn) is supported by LICENSE clause 1. io is fine (H&E or WSI + class text prompts + optional box -> per-class probability maps and a label mask). The use cases are supported by the paper, but the survival/TIS results were shown with the paper's model, not demonstrated for the released checkpoint. Year 2026 is correct.

name: OpenMidnight
reason: Clearly relevant older pathology tile encoder absent from baseline, met via the medarc SPECTRA adapters. Public-data replication and improvement of kaiko.ai Midnight by Sophont/MedARC with Apache-2.0 code and hub weights. Primary document is a technical blog post (precedent: H-optimus record cites a company announcement). Relationship: distinct weights from bfm-midnight-midnight-12k-midnight-92k; do not merge.

identity.note: Blog/technical report (sophont.med, authors Kaplan, Grandhi, Lane, Warner, Abraham, Scotti), GitHub MedARC-AI/OpenMidnight and HF SophontAI/OpenMidnight cross-link each other; the README cites the blog and the HF checkpoint, the blog links the repo and HF card, and the HF card links the repo. SophontAI is the authors' organisation, so this is not a third-party re-upload. The fix PR #77 was merged by PaulScotti, a listed author. Baseline identity TSV has no openmidnight/sophont/medarc entry (active or held). The model is distinct from bfm-midnight-midnight-12k-midnight-92k (kaiko.ai weights; OpenMidnight is an independent re-training by another group). Do not merge. Correction: the proposal missed a DOI-registered technical report. DataCite and Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.20711012 (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20711011) has the same title and six authors, resource type Report, publication_date 2025-11-14, CC BY 4.0 licence, deposited 2026-06-16, and one file, openmidnight.pdf.

scope.note: General-purpose pathology tile encoder: a 1.1B-parameter ViT-G/14 initialised from Meta's DINOv2 weights and further trained with DINOv2/iBOT self-supervision (250k steps, 8xH100) on about 12k TCGA FFPE H&E slides. Evaluated on 13 eva/HEST tasks covering patch classification, slide-level classification, segmentation and HEST gene-expression regression. Continued SSL pretraining of this size is not a thin fine-tune; the HF card's 'Finetuned DINOv2' wording refers to the initialisation. Modality 'spatial' is correct (pathology).

artifact.note: The HF API (unauthenticated, 200) lists teacher_checkpoint.pth (4,939,968,425 B) and teacher_checkpoint_load.pt (4,539,311,375 B), plus sample_dataset_30.txt and example PNGs. The resolve URL for the weights returns 401 (gated); weights were not downloaded. The model card is publicly readable on the model page (contrary to the proposal, which said the card text was unreadable; only /raw/README.md returns 401) and gives a torch.hub loading snippet. The repo provides training, eva and HEST evaluation code. The training-patch mirror medarc/TCGA-12K-parquet is on HF and ungated. The demo Space SophontAI/OpenMidnightDemo shows RUNTIME_ERROR, so it is not cited.

terms.note: Code: Apache-2.0 (gh api license, LICENSE file). Weights: HF cardData.license apache-2.0, gated='auto'. The gate prompt requires registration and contact sharing, says the HF primary email must match an institutional email 'to receive approval', and asks for attestation of affiliation and research use. The card's Terms of Use say the model is 'primarily intended for research purposes' and not for clinical diagnosis or treatment. No non-commercial clause in any artifact. Technical report: CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo). Training data mirror: no added licence; it follows TCGA/GDC Open Access terms. noncommercial=false is correct. The proposed status wording omits the gate conditions; corrected.

urls.note: All proposed URLs resolve and show what their labels claim: https://sophont.med/blog/openmidnight 200 (technical report page, Nov 14 2025); https://github.com/MedARC-AI/OpenMidnight 200; https://huggingface.co/SophontAI/OpenMidnight 200 (public card, gated files). Added https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20711012, which redirects (302) to https://zenodo.org/records/20711012 (200).

text.note: Four corrections. (1) The description says 'trained only on about 12,000 public TCGA slides', but the model starts from Meta's DINOv2 ViT-G/14 natural-image weights (README; card 'Initialization: Meta's DINOv2 pre-trained weights'). (2) 'with a KDE regulariser': the maintainer-merged PR #77 (2026-08-27) states the released 250k checkpoint was trained with a sign-inverted KDE term that rewarded collapse. vitg14_reg4.yaml has kde_loss_weight .05 and koleo_loss_weight 0. The descriptor is dropped and the caveat goes in audit_note. (3) 'improvement' is the authors' self-assessment; the record uses neutral 'replication'. (4) use_cases cited 'robustness adapters (e.g. SPECTRA)', a derivative already rejected in discovery and not a use of this model; replaced with the task families actually benchmarked (eva + HEST). io is refined to 224-px tile -> 1536-d embedding (card). year 2025 is correct (HF created 2025-11-12; report 2025-11-14). The audit_note claims 'no preprint' and 'card text not readable' are corrected.
